content.title: Chinese EVs are making inroads in North America. That worries industry experts
content.summary: Chinese automakers have been making inroads around the world with growing sales of their high-tech, stylish and affordable electric vehicles.  Experts now say an easier path into Canada could be a big boost for Chinese carmakers looking to dominate the global market — particularly as their domestic market weakens.  Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said the Chinese Communist Party invests in its auto industry to “control this industry.”
